create_ErrorHandler: create an ErrorHandler instance with a shared error queue to listen for child process errors
add_child_process: add a child process PID to the ErrorHandler so it can be terminated on error
raise_ChildException: raise a ChildException to wrap and propagate a traceback from a child process to the parent
listen_for_errors: start a daemon thread that listens on the error queue and triggers SIGUSR1 when an error arrives
handle_signal_SIGUSR1: handle a SIGUSR1 signal by killing all registered child processes and raising the child exception
